name: solid-qml-tsx-debug
description: Debug main.tsx in VS Code via the QML engine — a DAP proxy that remaps breakpoints/stops main.tsx <-> App.generated.qml through the transpiler's source map, on top of the qml-debug adapter.

port.description: Port the app's V4 debug server listens on (-qmljsdebugger=port:N).

tsxSource.description: Absolute path to the authored TSX (main.tsx).

generatedQml.description: Absolute path to the generated QML (loaded by the app as a filesystem path).

innerAdapter.description: Path to qml-debug's out/debug-adapter.js (auto-detected if the qml-debug extension is installed).

paths.description: qrc:/ -> directory map, forwarded to qml-debug (only needed if the app loads the QML from qrc rather than the filesystem).
